ops.title: Industrial Waste Reduction
ops.proof: Traced 79% of plant waste to weaving and proposed a fix with ~300 kg/day reduction potential.
ops.problem: At Welspun Vapi’s Terry Towels weaving unit, our project tackled a high-volume, structurally recurring waste problem in dobby loom production: mock-selvage trimming was generating ~2 kg of hard waste per loom per day, which scaled to nearly 300 kg/day across 168 looms (about 9,000 kg/month and 109,500 kg/year), much of it difficult to recycle because it was a mixed-fibre (polyester-cotton) waste stream.
approach: identified root cause in loom setup.
impact: ~300 kg/day hard-waste reduction potential (proposal, not a measured result).
~109,500 kg/year if implemented.

ops.title: INZEX Dashboards + Backend
ops.subtitle: Ops analytics & reporting
ops.proof: Three connected dashboards for three Myntra brands.
ops.problem: Inzex’s reporting workflow relied on fragmented spreadsheets and manual tracking, making it difficult to get a clear, timely view of campaign performance, operational KPIs, and decision-critical trends.
approach: Designed and deployed a centralized dashboarding workflow that consolidated fragmented operational and marketing data into a structured reporting system, using Excel-based data cleaning, KPI mapping, and visual summaries to make performance tracking faster, clearer, and more decision-ready.
impact: Sales and inventory joined into one self-refreshing view; no business outcome is claimed on its own.

ops.title: Sewing-Line Layout: WIP Point System
ops.proof: Re-sequenced a 21-operation denim line, lifting its material-flow index from 38% to 48% on the redesigned layout.
ops.problem: Bundles on the denim line travelled back and forth across several tables, operation times were uneven, and some operators sat idle while others queued work.
approach: mapped every WIP move on the floor plan.
scored each move by distance and direction.
re-sequenced machines and re-scored the layout.
impact: Material-flow index 38.2% → 48.2% on the proposed layout (calculated, not measured after a change).
ops.skills: Line balancing, precedence diagrams, layout planning.

ops.title: Operator Skill Rating: i-SMART Study
ops.proof: Compared eight ways of rating sewing operators and studied how NIFT's i-SMART system scores skill objectively.
ops.problem: Sewing skill was judged mainly on output quality and completion time, leaving out speed, handling time and needle running time.
impact: A desk study with five recommendations; no implementation results reported.
ops.skills: Work measurement, operator rating, industrial engineering research.
